headline: Maui County Council Meeting

meeting.summary: The council advanced a Hawaiian Homelands wells plan nine to zero and sent a coastal hotel-rezoning resolution to planners, five to four.
meeting.recap: Members voted nine to zero for a workers' compensation settlement (a payment to close a job-injury claim).[[2:37:30]] Members voted nine to zero to accept a playground donation worth about $142,370 for Lahaina.[[3:01:19]] Bill 97 sets up a county agreement with Hawaiian Homelands to develop three wells.[[3:03:59]] Members advanced the wells measure nine to zero.[[3:09:18]] Eight members, with one excused, backed a bill to send help to Kauaʻi after Hurricane Lowell.[[3:40:05]] It passed nine to zero.[[3:54:14]] Both bills passed nine to zero on final reading.[[3:58:56]] Resolution 26-129 asks the Maui Planning Commission to weigh hotel zoning, allowing vacation rentals, for coastal hazard-area apartment properties.[[4:03:43]] The chair said the Planning Commission approved five of 48 properties from an earlier list.[[4:23:35]] The committee report backing the resolution passed, five to four.[[4:57:23]]
decided: A member moved to approve a report on Bill 85, letting Planning Commission hearing notices run in any countywide publication instead of only a newspaper, but the vote is not in the recording.
meeting.next: The Seabury Hall request goes to the Maui Planning Commission before council committees hear it. The vice chair agreed to discuss the sister city relationship further in her committee.

issues.oneLine: The council advanced Bill 97, an agreement to develop three wells on Hawaiian Homelands land.
issues.brief: A testifier said moving water out of the Upcountry plan district would break the county's general plan.[[#1]] Members approved the committee report nine to zero.[[#2]]

issues.oneLine: The council sent a list of coastal apartment-zoned properties to the Maui Planning Commission to consider hotel zoning.
issues.why: The committee chair said these properties are costly to maintain in hazard areas and may not suit long-term housing.
issues.next: The Maui Planning Commission will review the proposed rezoning bills.
issues.brief: The Office of Hawaiian Affairs testified against the resolution.[[#1]] The chair said the Planning Commission approved five of 48 properties from an earlier list.[[#2]] The committee report passed five to four.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The council advanced a bill letting Maui County help Kauaʻi recover from Hurricane Lowell.
issues.why: A member said she wants to help Kauaʻi because of the help it gave Maui after the fire.
issues.next: A donated playground project in Lahaina is scheduled for December 2026.
issues.brief: A testifier said Lahaina town remains largely unbuilt since the August 2023 fires.[[#1]] A member said the playground gift supports West Maui's fire recovery.[[#2]]
